full_name: Debra Blumenthal | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2003–2004 History Sargent-Faull Fellow University of Kansas
bio: Debra Blumenthal is a historian at the University of California at Santa Barbara whose research interests center around late medieval Iberian history; Muslim, Christian, and Jewish interaction in the medieval Mediterranean world; and comparative slavery.
